title: 2008 HMMT November Guts Problem 36
statement: How many numbers less than \(1,000,000\) are the product of exactly 2 distinct primes? You will receive \(\left\lfloor 25-50 \cdot\left|\frac{N}{A}-1\right|\right\rfloor\) points, if you submit \(N\) and the correct answer is \(A\).

solutions.text: 209867 While it is difficult to compute this answer without writing a program or using a calculator, it can be approximated using the fact that the number of primes less than a positive integer \(n\) is about \(\frac{n}{\log n}\).
